filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Wed Nov 11 (after the morning run) – Thu Nov 12 morning PT, plus one Nov 10 Salesloft item the Nov 11 brief missed (items already on the Nov 10–11 briefs not re-led)

market_briefing.lede: In-call help is moving into the meeting platform itself, and always-on agents that come back with decisions are spreading beyond revenue tools: Salesloft now shows battlecards inside Zoom with no meeting bot, and Databricks turned Genie into a background agent with its own inbox.

bullets.text: Nov 10: Salesloft's live battlecards are available in Zoom. When a buyer names a competitor or raises pricing, the approved talking points appear in the Salesloft app in Zoom's side panel; it uses Zoom Realtime Media Streams, so no bot joins, and Salesloft says it does not extend to Teams or Google Meet.

Nov 11: Databricks' second-generation Genie runs in the background on its own compute, delegates to subagents, and surfaces decisions through a priority inbox and email; it stays inside Unity Catalog permissions and Unity Gateway approval rules and budgets, and is priced on usage rather than per seat. The always-on mode is coming to preview and beta.

Nov 11: Attio made its top CRM tier self-serve. Ultra is $1,000 a month with 5 users (annual billing), 20,000 workspace credits, SQL access through API or MCP, and SSO, SCIM and audit logs; Pro teams can buy that governance as a $30-per-user add-on.

biggest_ai_news.title: Google launches the Gemini Decisions API
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 11: Gemini Decision 1 scores up to 1,000 yes/no, multiple-choice, or rubric questions against one multimodal input in a single pass, in 150–250 ms, at $0.10 per 1M input tokens with no output charges. Google lists model routing, tool selection, and policy checks as uses.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI's quarterly revenue passes $10 billion
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 11 (WSJ, via Reuters): third-quarter revenue rose about 50% from the prior quarter to over $10B, with an operating loss of $10.9B.

biggest_ai_news.title: Chip and cloud suppliers commit $26B to Anthropic alongside the IPO
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 10–11: Alphabet, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC Partners will buy $26B of shares in a private placement at the IPO price; the Motley Fool reports Nvidia and Alphabet at $10B each. The IPO itself is 825M shares at $70–$78.

biggest_ai_news.title: Databricks turns Genie into an always-on enterprise agent
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 11: background autonomous mode, subagents, priority inbox, Genie Ontology (GA) and Genie Search across 100+ sources; Genie is reachable from ChatGPT, Claude and Copilot through Genie MCP.

what_changed.title: Salesloft ships live battlecards inside Zoom
what_changed.body: Nov 10: real-time coaching agents listen for topics the team configured (a competitor, a pricing objection, a requirement) and show the matching battlecard in Zoom's side panel; a Zoom admin approves the app, and participants are notified. This is the first piece of the Oct 27 early-access announcement to become available; Salesloft's roadmap adds in-call signals, compliance guardrails, and starting AI Sales Plays from the live call.

what_changed.title: Attio replaces quote-only Enterprise with a self-serve $1,000/month Ultra plan
what_changed.body: Nov 11: Ultra includes 5 users (extra users $189/month, annual only), 20,000 workspace credits, unlimited objects, SQL through API or MCP, a data connector, SSO, SCIM, audit logs, and forward-deployed onboarding. SSO, SCIM and audit logs are now a $30/user/month Governance add-on on Pro.

what_changed.title: Databricks launches always-on Genie with a governed business ontology
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 11: Genie keeps long-running work moving, follows up on missing inputs, and emails users when a decision is needed; examples include keeping a quarterly forecast on track and alerting account teams to usage shifts. Genie and Genie Ontology are GA; always-on Genie, Genie Search and Ontology Manager are coming to preview and beta.

quiet_note: No new launch, funding, M&A or pricing from Salesforce, Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach or Monaco dated Nov 11–12. Salesforce's Nov 11 X post on AI Skills repeats the Nov 10 GA; Clay's Nov 11 X post lists customer results without a launch. Salesloft newsroom still tops out at the Oct 27 early-access post.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (live, in-call assistance)
market_direction.text: Salesloft's Zoom battlecards (Nov 10) follow Claude Meetings (Nov 10); both put help inside the call rather than after it, and Salesloft does it without a bot.

market_direction.label: Accelerating (background agents that report back)
market_direction.text: Databricks' always-on Genie (Nov 11) works on a goal and returns with decisions through an inbox and email, under existing data permissions and spending caps.

market_direction.label: New (self-serve top-tier CRM with usage credits)
market_direction.text: Attio's Ultra plan (Nov 11) puts SSO, SCIM, audit logs and SQL over MCP behind a card checkout with a fixed credit pool and paid overages.

market_direction.label: Steady (rest of watchlist)
market_direction.text: Salesforce, Gong, Clay, Nooks, Outreach and Monaco had no new launches Nov 11–12.

language_pulse.gloss: Salesloft's approved talking points that appear in Zoom when a buyer raises a flagged topic (Nov 10).
Zoom Realtime Media Streams, which lets an app receive the meeting live without a bot participant (Salesloft, Nov 10).
Databricks' agent that runs in the background on its own compute and reaches out when it needs a decision (Nov 11).
Databricks' continuously maintained map of a company's definitions, metrics, people and processes (Nov 11).
Google's endpoint that scores closed-set questions instead of generating text (Nov 11).

competitive_moves.text: Live battlecards in Zoom's side panel via Zoom RTMS, no meeting bot, Zoom only (Nov 10).
Self-serve Ultra plan at $1,000/month with 5 users and 20,000 credits; governance split into a Pro add-on (Nov 11).

watch.title: Anthropic IPO pricing (reported Nov 18) and Claude Data default-on Nov 19; Salesforce Hunter and Coworker November GA items
watch.body: Pricing is reported for Nov 18 with trading expected Nov 19. Anthropic turns Claude Data on by default for Enterprise orgs on Nov 19. Salesforce listed its Hunter outbound sales agent as GA in November and Coworker in Teams and the desktop/mobile apps for November; neither GA has been announced yet.

interpretation.fact: Nov 10 Salesloft made live battlecards available in Zoom through Zoom RTMS. Nov 11 Attio launched a self-serve $1,000/month Ultra plan. Nov 11 Databricks announced always-on Genie and GA of Genie Ontology. Nov 11 Google launched the Gemini Decisions API. Nov 11 WSJ reported OpenAI Q3 revenue above $10B. Nov 10 Anthropic's prospectus listed a $26B private placement from seven technology companies.
interpretation.interpretation: Salesloft's bot-free Zoom path is a distribution advantage over meeting-bot tools, but it ties the feature to one video platform. Attio and Databricks both pair agents with credit or usage billing and governance controls, which keeps pushing buyers to compare revenue tools on usage cost and admin controls, not seat price alone.
